Milk.name: Milk
Milk.risk: Contains milk proteins or lactose; can trigger severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) or digestive intolerance.

Peanuts.name: Peanuts
Peanuts.risk: High risk of severe, life-threatening allergic reactions (anaphylaxis), even with trace exposure.

Soy.name: Soy
Soy.risk: May cause hypersensitivity reactions including hives, swelling, or digestive issues in soy-sensitive individuals.

Egg.name: Egg
Egg.risk: Common trigger for pediatric and adult allergies; can cause skin rashes, respiratory symptoms, or anaphylaxis.

Wheat & Gluten.name: Wheat & Gluten
Wheat & Gluten.risk: Triggers allergic responses in wheat-allergic individuals and causes severe intestinal damage in people with Celiac disease.

Tree Nuts.name: Tree Nuts
Tree Nuts.risk: Frequently linked to severe, systemic allergic reactions and anaphylaxis.

Fish.name: Fish
Fish.risk: Can cause strong, lifelong allergic reactions; often persists into adulthood.

Shellfish.name: Shellfish
Shellfish.risk: Highly potent allergen group; can trigger sudden and severe cardiovascular or respiratory distress.

Sesame.name: Sesame
Sesame.risk: Recognized globally as a major allergen; can induce hives, abdominal pain, or anaphylaxis.

Mustard.name: Mustard
Mustard.risk: Can prompt severe allergic reactions, skin irritation, or respiratory discomfort in sensitive individuals.

Celery.name: Celery
Celery.risk: Common allergen in European regions; can cause reactions ranging from mild oral allergy syndrome to severe anaphylaxis.
